# Nimbus Trust Center

> Continuous assurance for a simulated company: real controls, live evidence, governed AI.

Nimbus is a fictional company; all company data is illustrative. The AI assistants, the evidence job, the vendors with trust centers, and the build gates are real and can be inspected.

- Live: https://nimbus-trust-center.vercel.app
- Source and tests: https://github.com/TC26-max/Nimbus_Trust_Center
- Version: 1.0.0

## Views
- #trust: public trust center
- #overview, #controls, #ai, #evidence, #risks, #vendors, #board, #tested, #glossary: the control room

## API
- POST /api/map {q}: maps one questionnaire question to up to three controls (rate limited, no storage)
- GET /api/health: status probe
